description:
Access Control System (ACS) maintenance services capable of managing control of at least 328 access-controlled doors and 79 monitored only doors located across 14 individual buildings on Wright-Patterson AFB IAW the attached performance work statement.

CAUTION:  This Sources Sought is issued solely for information and planning purposes.  In accordance with Part 10 of the Federal Acquisition Regulation, the U.S. Government is conducting market research.  The intended purpose is to identify potential sources that may possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet AFLCMC's requirments.
